records.title: Trail-adjacent terrain screening
records.supported_claim: Percent cell slope within150m of mapped trails and terrain below selected trail raster cells within100m.
records.limitations: 10-15m output service cells; native contributing resolution unresolved. Not trail-tread grade, surveyed cliff height or horse-safety classification.
records.recheck: Use current terrain/route observations, snow conditions and manager advice before a trip; this dated planning product does not establish safe passage.

records.title: NOAA station snow normals
records.supported_claim: 1991-2020 monthly snowfall normals and midmonth probability of observed depth>=1inch; station elevations and completeness flags.
records.limitations: Point data, varying valid year counts; not spatial interpolation or trip probability.
records.recheck: Use current terrain/route observations, snow conditions and manager advice before a trip; this dated planning product does not establish safe passage.

records.title: Monthly satellite snow-cover ensemble
records.supported_claim: Published monthly p50 snow-cover ensemble of DLR and ESA inputs, clipped without resampling.
records.limitations: Exploratory, initial accuracy; average of source medians; component periods differ; ESA processing partly unreproduced; not calibrated snow-day chance or snow depth.
records.recheck: Use current terrain/route observations, snow conditions and manager advice before a trip; this dated planning product does not establish safe passage.

records.title: ENSO context for Utah
records.supported_claim: El Nino and La Nina can affect broad winter patterns; Utah response is inconsistent.
records.limitations: No route-specific October forecast or numeric ENSO adjustment is supported.
records.recheck: Use current terrain/route observations, snow conditions and manager advice before a trip; this dated planning product does not establish safe passage.
